rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Greedy Eater
abilities.text: If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Dark Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Bouffalant ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bouffer
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gold Breaker
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Hilda
rules: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Force
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Reshiram ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Blazing Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Regal Cheer
abilities.text: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Command the Grass
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Petilil

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Maractus

attacks.name: Lively Needles
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Foongus

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Reaction
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Force
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Torrid Scales
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Panpour

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Tympole

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Tirtouga

attacks.name: Ancient Seaweed
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile.

flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Mighty Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Alomomola

abilities.name: Gentle Fin
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench.

flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Snotted Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Beartic

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: Kyurem ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Blizzard Burst
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Emolga

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Buzz Flip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Disaster Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

name: Zekrom ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Voltage Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Munna

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

name: Musharna

attacks.name: Dream Calling
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion

attacks.name: Cellular Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus

attacks.name: Cellular Ascension
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Evo-Lariat
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Evolution Pokémon in play.

flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Slight Shift
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Golett

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Meloetta ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Debut Performance
abilities.text: If you go first, this Pokémon can use attacks during your first turn.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 80 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Excadrill ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Piercing Drill
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

name: Timburr
flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr

abilities.name: Craftsmanship
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each Fighting Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

name: Throh

attacks.name: Shoulder Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 less damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Landorus

attacks.name: Abundant Harvest
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

name: Venipede

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Sandile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand.

flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Cursed Slug
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Wild Lances
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Klink

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Klinklang

abilities.name: Gear Coating
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have any Metal Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Cobalion

attacks.name: Righteous Edge
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Arms
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Genesect ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metallic Signal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Evolution Metal Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Axew

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Haxorus

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Axe Blast
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.

flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Pidove

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Unfezant

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.text: Draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Swift Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Audino

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Minccino

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Rufflet
flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Air Balloon

Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

name: Antique Cover Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

abilities.name: Protective Cover
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Energy Coin
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Fennel
rules: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: N's Plan
rules: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Pokégear 3.0
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Professor's Research
rules: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Prism Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Petilil

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Maractus

attacks.name: Lively Needles
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Foongus

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Reaction
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Torrid Scales
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Panpour

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Tympole

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Tirtouga

attacks.name: Ancient Seaweed
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile.

flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Mighty Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Alomomola

abilities.name: Gentle Fin
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench.

flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Snotted Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Beartic

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: Emolga

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Buzz Flip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Munna

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

name: Musharna

attacks.name: Dream Calling
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Solosis
flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion

attacks.name: Cellular Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Slight Shift
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Golett

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Timburr
flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom

attacks.name: Disperse Drool
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Pollen Bomb
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Lively Flower
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Mega Heracross ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Juggernaut Horn
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage.

attacks.name: Mountain Ramming
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

name: Lotad
flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

name: Lombre

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Excited Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have any Grass Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Genesect

attacks.name: Bug's Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Nymble

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix

attacks.name: Jumping Shot
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Charmander

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

flavorText: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Mega Charizard X ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Inferno X
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Moltres

attacks.name: Fighting Wings
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Burning Flare
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Oricorio ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Excited Turbo
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any Fire Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Infernal Slash
attacks.text: Discard 4 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Seel

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.

attacks.name: Blizzard Edge
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Suicune

attacks.name: Crystal Fall
attacks.text: If you have at least 4 Water Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Piplup

attacks.name: Call for Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Targeted Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

name: Rotom ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Multi Adapter
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Yamper

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund

attacks.name: Electric Run
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot

attacks.name: Voltaic Fist
attacks.text: You may have this Pokémon also do 60 damage to itself and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Mismagius ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Swirling Prose
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hexa-Magic
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Granbull

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Swelling Light
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Soothing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon.

flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Mega Diancie ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Diamond Coat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Garland Ray
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Sweet Circle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Zacian

attacks.name: Limit Break
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Place 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast

abilities.name: Prison Panic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Make your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Paldean Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Charge
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon that has "Tauros" in its name that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

name: Gligar

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

name: Flygon

abilities.name: Sandy Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Mega Gengar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shadowy Concealment
abilities.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Void Gale
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Sniping Feathers
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sableye

attacks.name: Cocky Claw
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Mega Sharpedo ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Greedy Fang
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Hungry Jaws
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 150 more damage.

name: Seviper

abilities.name: Excited Power
abilities.text: If you have any Darkness Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Absol

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok

name: Raboot
flavorText: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump

flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Totodile

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Beset

flavorText: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile

attacks.name: Hail Claw
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: Mega Froslass ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Resentful Refrain
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Absolute Snow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Regice ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Regi Charge
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ice Prison
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: N's Vanillite

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: N's Vanillish

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

attacks.name: Snow Coating
attacks.text: Double the number of damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Snom
flavorText: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth

abilities.name: Alluring Wings
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Each player draws a card.

attacks.name: Cold Cyclone
attacks.text: Move a Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Glastrier

attacks.name: Ice Shot
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Frosty Typhoon
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Frosty Typhoon.

flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Raichu

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hundred-Hitting Ball

name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

attacks.name: Disaster Shock
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Pouncing Trap
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 100 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk

abilities.name: Frilled Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you played Canari from your hand this turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Powerful Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Tapu Koko

attacks.name: Fast Flight
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Hop's Pincurchin ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Counterattack Quills
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiky Thunder
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Iono's Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Iono's Bellibolt ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Electric Streamer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Iono's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

name: Iono's Wattrel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Iono's Kilowattrel

abilities.name: Flashing Draw
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Miraidon ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hadron Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 120 more damage.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Lillie's Clefairy ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fairy Zone
abilities.text: The Weakness of each of your opponent's Dragon Pokémon in play is now Psychic. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor

attacks.name: Tri Kinesis
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If all of them are heads, Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless you have 4 or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Erasure Ball
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Togepi
flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Wonder Kiss
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn't stack.

flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

name: Marill

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bubble Gathering
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move an Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energized Balloon
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Assassin's Magic
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Ralts

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Call Sign
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Mega Gardevoir ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette

attacks.name: Cursed Words

flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Rotom

attacks.name: Roto Call
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Pokémon that have "Rotom" in their name and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Gadget Show

flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Phantump

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

attacks.name: Horrifying Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Hop's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu

attacks.name: Gemstone Mimicry

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Spectrier

attacks.name: Phantasmal Barrage
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon and place 12 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Munkidori

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Team Rocket's Diglett

attacks.name: Relentless Burrowing
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio

abilities.name: Holes
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Spin and Draw
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Seventh Kick
attacks.text: If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.

name: Lunatone

abilities.name: Lunar Cycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn.

flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock

attacks.name: Cosmic Beam
attacks.text: If you don't have Lunatone on your Bench, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Regirock ex

attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Rock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage.

name: Groudon

attacks.name: Megaton Fall
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Cynthia's Gible

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Cynthia's Gabite

abilities.name: Champion's Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Cynthia's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

attacks.name: Mega Brave
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.

name: Stunfisk ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Flopping Trap
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Pancham

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Mega Hawlucha ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Tenacious Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Somersault Dive
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 140 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fighting and Psychic type.

attacks.name: Counter Jewel
attacks.text: If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal

attacks.name: Tar Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 140 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you don't have 10 or more Basic Fighting Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does nothing. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bulky Bump
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Koraidon ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).

attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Impact Blow
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Impact Blow.

name: Okidogi

attacks.name: Settle the Score
attacks.text: This attack does 60 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took during their last turn.

flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Mega Gengar ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
